translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Yang Junmin, erudite of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was ordered to perform sacrifices at the Confucian temple in Qufu and also to repair the temple buildings.

sentences.zh: 詔諭：「山東鹽法，軍民毋得沮壞。

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed: "The salt laws of Shandong must not be obstructed or undermined by soldiers or civilians."
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed: "The salt laws of Shandong must not be obstructed or undermined by soldiers or civilians."

sentences.zh: 」賜定住篤憐赤、怯薛丹三十名，給衣糧、馬匹、草料。

translations.literal: Dingzhu was granted thirty dulanchi and keshig guards, with clothing, provisions, horses, and fodder supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhu was granted thirty dulanchi and keshig guards, with clothing, provisions, horses, and fodder supplied.

sentences.zh: 是月，高郵張士誠陷平江路，據之，改平江路為隆平府，遂陷湖州、松江、常州。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Shicheng of Gaoyou seized Pingjiang Circuit and held it; he changed Pingjiang Circuit to Longping Prefecture, then seized Huzhou, Songjiang, and Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Shicheng of Gaoyou seized Pingjiang Circuit and held it; he changed Pingjiang Circuit to Longping Prefecture, then seized Huzhou, Songjiang, and Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 月辛巳，復立酒課提舉司。

translations.literal: In the month, on the xinsi day, the Wine-Tax Intendant's Office was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinsi day, the Wine-Tax Intendant's Office was reestablished.

sentences.zh: 命中書平章政事帖裏帖木兒、參知政事成遵等議鈔法。

translations.literal: Tieli Temür, associate chief minister of the Secretariat, and Cheng Zun, vice chief minister, and others were ordered to deliberate on the paper currency system.
translations.idiomatic: Tieli Temür, associate chief minister of the Secretariat, and Cheng Zun, vice chief minister, and others were ordered to deliberate on the paper currency system.

sentences.zh: 壬午，徐壽輝復寇襄陽。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, Xu Shouhui again raided Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Xu Shouhui again raided Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，臺臣言：「系官牧馬草地，俱為權豪所占。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, censorial officials said: "Government horse-grazing pastures have all been seized by powerful families.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, censorial officials said: "Government horse-grazing pastures have all been seized by powerful families.

sentences.zh: 今後除規運總管府見種外，余盡取勘，令大司農召募耕墾，歲收租課以資國用。

translations.literal: Henceforth, aside from what the Guiyun Directorate is currently cultivating, the remainder should all be surveyed and turned over; the Grand Agribureau should recruit people to reclaim and cultivate them, and the annual rent and tax should be collected to support state revenue."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, aside from what the Guiyun Directorate is currently cultivating, the remainder should all be surveyed and turned over; the Grand Agribureau should recruit people to reclaim and cultivate them, and the annual rent and tax should be collected to support state revenue."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以今秋出師，詔和買馬六萬匹。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, because troops would march out this autumn, an edict ordered compulsory purchase of sixty thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, because troops would march out this autumn, an edict ordered compulsory purchase of sixty thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命宣讓王帖木兒不花、威順王寬徹普化以兵鎮遏懷慶路，各賜金一錠、銀五錠、幣帛九匹、鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, Temür Buhua, Prince of Proclaiming and Yielding, and Kuancha Puhua, Prince of Weishun, were ordered to hold Huaiqing Circuit with troops; each was granted one ingot of gold, five ingots of silver, nine bolts of silks and fabrics, and two thousand ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Temür Buhua, Prince of Proclaiming and Yielding, and Kuancha Puhua, Prince of Weishun, were ordered to hold Huaiqing Circuit with troops; each was granted one ingot of gold, five ingots of silver, nine bolts of silks and fabrics, and two thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大明兵取集慶路，江南行臺御史大夫福壽死之。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Great Ming troops took Jiqing Circuit; Fushou, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Great Ming troops took Jiqing Circuit; Fushou, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 丙申，倪文俊陷常德路，總兵官俺都剌遁。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, Ni Wenjun seized Changde Circuit; Andu'la, overall military commander, fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Ni Wenjun seized Changde Circuit; Andu'la, overall military commander, fled.

sentences.zh: 命搠思監提調承徽寺。

translations.literal: Suosijian was ordered to supervise the Chenghui Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Suosijian was ordered to take charge of the Chenghui Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，立行樞密院於杭州。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, a branch Bureau of Military Affairs was established at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, a branch bureau of military affairs was established at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 命江浙行省左丞相達識帖睦邇兼知行樞密院事，節制諸軍，省、院等官並聽調遣，凡賞功、罰罪、招降、討逆，許以便宜行事。

translations.literal: Dash Temür, left chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was additionally ordered to act as director of the branch Bureau of Military Affairs, to command all armies; officials of the secretariat, bureau, and other offices were all to obey his orders; in rewarding merit, punishing crime, accepting surrender, and suppressing rebellion, he was permitted to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Dash Temür, left chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was additionally ordered to act as director of the branch bureau of military affairs, to command all armies; officials of the secretariat, bureau, and other offices were all to obey his orders; in rewarding merit, punishing crime, accepting surrender, and suppressing rebellion, he was permitted to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 大明兵取鎮江路。

translations.literal: Great Ming troops took Zhenjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Great Ming troops captured Zhenjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，方國珍復降，以為海道運糧漕運萬戶，兼防禦海道運糧萬戶。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Fang Guozhen submitted again; he was appointed commander of ten thousand of sea-route grain transport and grain-shipping transport, and concurrently commander of ten thousand for defending sea-route grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Fang Guozhen submitted again and was appointed commander of ten thousand for sea-route grain transport and grain-shipping transport, concurrently serving as commander of ten thousand for defending sea-route grain transport.

sentences.zh: 其兄方國璋為衢州路總管，兼防禦海道事。

translations.literal: His elder brother Fang Guozhang was made prefect of Quzhou Circuit, concurrently charged with defending the sea routes.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Fang Guozhang was appointed prefect of Quzhou Circuit, with concurrent responsibility for defending the sea routes.

sentences.zh: 是月，有兩日相蕩。

translations.literal: That month, two suns swayed against each other.
translations.idiomatic: That month, two suns appeared to oscillate against each other in the sky.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，以搠思監為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, Tosem was made left chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the xinhai day of the fourth month, Tosem was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以資正院使普化為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Puhua, commissioner of the Bureau of Rectifying Governance, was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Puhua, commissioner of the Bureau of Rectifying Governance, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命左丞相搠思監領經筵事，中書平章政事悟良哈臺、御史大夫普化並知經筵事。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, left chief minister Tosem was ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium; Wulianghatai, chief minister of the Secretariat, and Censor-in-Chief Puhua were both made associate directors of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, left chief minister Tosem was ordered to direct the Classics Colloquium, while Wulianghatai, chief minister of the Secretariat, and Censor-in-Chief Puhua were both appointed associate directors of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以河南行省左丞卜蘭奚為湖廣行省平章政事，答失八都魯加金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Bolanxi, left vice director of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was made chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat; Dashibadu'er was advanced to Grand Master of Golden Countersign and Purple Radiance.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Bolanxi, left vice director of the Henan branch secretariat, was appointed chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, and Dashibadu'er was advanced to Grand Master of Golden Countersign and Purple Radiance.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命阿因班太子與陜西行省官同討均、房、南陽。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Prince Ayanban was ordered to join Shaanxi branch secretariat officials in jointly attacking Jun, Fang, and Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Prince Ayanban was ordered to join officials of the Shaanxi branch secretariat in a joint campaign against Jun, Fang, and Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 遼陽行省平章政事奇伯顏不花加大司徒。

translations.literal: Qibayan Buhua, chief minister of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, was made grand steward.
translations.idiomatic: Qibayan Buhua, chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat, was appointed grand steward.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以陜西行臺御史大夫朵朵為陜西行省左丞相，大司農咬咬為遼陽行省左丞相。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Duoduo, censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, was made left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; Yao Yao, director of the Grand Agribureau, was made left chief minister of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Duoduo, censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi branch censorate, was appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, and Yao Yao, director of the Grand Agribureau, was appointed left chief minister of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以知樞密院事實理門分院濟寧，翰林學士承旨脫脫同知詹事院事。

translations.literal: Shilimen, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to branch out at Jining; Tuotuo, academician-expositor of the Hanlin Academy, was made associate director of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Shilimen, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to establish a branch office at Jining, and Tuotuo, academician-expositor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed associate director of the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命豫王阿剌忒納失裏與陜西行省官商議軍機，從宜攻討。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Prince Arad Temür was ordered to consult with Shaanxi branch secretariat officials on military affairs and attack and suppress as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Prince Arad Temür was ordered to consult with officials of the Shaanxi branch secretariat on military affairs and to attack and suppress as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命悟良哈臺兼太子諭德。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Wulianghatai was ordered concurrently to serve as tutor to the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Wulianghatai was ordered to serve concurrently as tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，太白犯鬼宿，癸巳，亦如之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renchen day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion; on guisi day, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renchen day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion; on the guisi day, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰入斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the moon entered the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the moon entered the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙申，倪文俊陷澧州路。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Ni Wenjun took Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Ni Wenjun captured Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賊寇辰州，守將和尚以鄉兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: On yisi day, bandits raided Chen Prefecture; the defending general Heshang defeated them with local militia.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, bandits raided Chen Prefecture; the defending general Heshang routed them with local militia.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，江浙行省平章政事三旦八、參知政事楊完者以兵守嘉興路，禦張士誠。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day, San Danba, chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, and Yang Wanze, vice chief minister, led troops to defend Jiaxing Circuit against Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiayin day, San Danba, chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Yang Wanze, vice chief minister, led troops to defend Jiaxing Circuit against Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大明兵取廣德路。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Great Ming troops took Guangde Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Great Ming troops captured Guangde Circuit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，以翰林學士禿魯帖木兒為侍御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guiwei day, Tulu Temür, academician of the Hanlin Academy, was made attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the guiwei day of the seventh month, Tulu Temür, academician of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 是月，張士誠遣兵陷杭州，江浙行省平章政事左答納失裏戰死，丞相達識帖睦邇遁，楊完者及萬戶普賢奴擊敗之，復其城。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Shicheng dispatched troops and took Hangzhou; Zuo Danashiri, chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, died in battle, Chief Minister Dash Temür fled, and Yang Wanze together with Commander of Ten Thousand Puxiannu defeated the enemy and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Shicheng dispatched troops and captured Hangzhou; Zuo Danashiri, chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, died in battle, Chief Minister Dash Temür fled, and Yang Wanze together with Commander of Ten Thousand Puxiannu routed the enemy and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，奉元路判官王淵等以義兵復商州，升淵同知關商襄鄧等處宣慰司事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingchen day, Wang Yuan, assistant magistrate of Fengyuan Circuit, and others with righteous militia recovered Shang Prefecture; Yuan was promoted to associate director of the Guan-Shang-Xiang-Deng Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingchen day, Wang Yuan, assistant magistrate of Fengyuan Circuit, and others with righteous militia recovered Shang Prefecture; Yuan was promoted to associate director of the Guan-Shang-Xiang-Deng Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 己未，賊侵河南府路，參知政事洪醜驢以兵敗之。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, bandits invaded Henan Prefecture Circuit; Hong Choulü, vice chief minister, defeated them with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, bandits invaded Henan Prefecture Circuit; Hong Choulü, vice chief minister, routed them with troops.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Mao mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Mao mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚午，倪文俊陷衡州路，元帥甄崇福戰死。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Ni Wenjun took Heng Prefecture; Marshal Zhen Chongfu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Ni Wenjun captured Heng Prefecture; Marshal Zhen Chongfu died in battle.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，彗星見張宿，色青白，彗指西南，長尺餘，至十二月戊午始滅。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, a comet appeared at the Extended Net mansion, bluish-white in color, its tail pointing southwest, more than a foot long; it did not disappear until the wuwu day of the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, a comet appeared at the Extended Net mansion, bluish-white in color with its tail pointing southwest and more than a foot in length; it remained visible until the wuwu day of the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 黃河決，山東大水。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks; Shandong suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks and Shandong suffered catastrophic flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，汝、潁賊李武、崔德等破潼關，參知政事述律傑戰死。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengchen day, the bandits Li Wu and Cui De of Ru and Ying broke through Tong Pass; Vice Chief Minister Shulu Jie died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengchen day, the bandits Li Wu and Cui De of Ru and Ying broke through Tong Pass; Vice Chief Minister Shulu Jie died in battle.

sentences.zh: 壬午，豫王阿剌忒納失裏、同知樞密院事定住引兵復潼關，河南行省平章政事伯家奴以兵守之。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Prince Arad Temür and Dingzhu, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, led troops and recovered Tong Pass; Bojianu, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, garrisoned it with troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Prince Arad Temür and Dingzhu, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, led troops and recovered Tong Pass; Bojianu, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, garrisoned it with troops.

sentences.zh: 丙申，潼關復陷，伯家奴兵潰，豫王阿剌忒納失裏復以兵取之，李武、崔德敗走。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Tong Pass fell again; Bojianu's army was routed; Prince Arad Temür again took it with troops; Li Wu and Cui De were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Tong Pass fell again and Bojianu's army was routed; Prince Arad Temür retook it with troops, and Li Wu and Cui De were defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賊陷陜州及虢州。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, bandits took Shaan Prefecture and Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, bandits captured Shaan Prefecture and Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔以太尉納麟復為江南行臺御史大夫，遷行臺治紹興。

translations.literal: An edict restored Grand Marshal Nalin as censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate and moved the branch censorate's seat to Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored Grand Marshal Nalin as censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate and moved the branch censorate's seat to Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 是月，察罕帖木兒復陜州及虢州，復襲敗賊兵於平陸、安邑，以功由兵部尚書升僉河北行樞密院事。

translations.literal: That month, Chaghan Temür recovered Shaan Prefecture and Guo Prefecture, and again routed bandit troops at Pinglu and Anyi; for his merit he was promoted from minister of the Bureau of War to vice director of the Hebei Branch Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chaghan Temür recovered Shaan Prefecture and Guo Prefecture and again routed bandit troops at Pinglu and Anyi; for his merit he was promoted from minister of the Bureau of War to vice director of the Hebei branch bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，大名路有星如火，從東南流，芒尾如曳篲，墮地有聲，火焰蓬勃，久之乃息，化為石，青黑色，光瑩，形如狗頭，其斷處如新割者，命藏於庫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingwei day, in Daming Circuit there was a star like fire flowing from the southeast; its tail like a trailing broom fell to earth with a sound; flames blazed vigorously and after a long time subsided, turning into stone, bluish-black and lustrous, shaped like a dog's head; its broken surface was like a fresh cut; an order was issued to store it in the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the dingwei day of the tenth month, in Daming Circuit a fireball streaked from the southeast with a tail like a trailing broom; it struck the earth with a sound as flames blazed vigorously, and after a long while subsided into a lustrous bluish-black stone shaped like a dog's head, its fracture surface like a fresh cut; an order was issued to store it in the treasury.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔罷太尉也先帖木兒。

translations.literal: That month, an edict dismissed Grand Marshal Yeshan Temür.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict dismissed Grand Marshal Yeshan Temür from office.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以老的沙、答裏麻失裏並為詹事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingxu day, Laodisha and Darimashi were both made superintendents of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingxu day, Laodisha and Darimashi were both appointed superintendents of the Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，流星大如酒杯，色青白，尾跡約長五尺餘，光明燭地，起自東北，東南行，沒於近濁，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, a meteor as large as a wine cup, bluish-white in color, with a tail trace about five feet long, shone so brightly as to illuminate the ground; it rose from the northeast, traveled southeastward, and vanished near the turbid quarter with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, a meteor as large as a wine cup, bluish-white in color with a tail trace of more than five feet, blazed so brightly as to illuminate the ground; it rose from the northeast, traveled southeastward, and vanished near the turbid quarter with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太陰犯井宿。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the moon transgressed the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南陷，河南廉訪副使俺普遁。

translations.literal: That month, Henan fell; Aipu, vice censor of the Henan Surveillance Commission, fled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Henan fell; Aipu, vice censor of the Henan Surveillance Commission, fled.

sentences.zh: 置河南廉訪司於沂州，又於沂州設分樞密院，以兵馬指揮使司隸之。

translations.literal: The Henan Surveillance Commission was established at Yi Prefecture, and a branch bureau of military affairs was also set up at Yi Prefecture, with the commandery of horse-and-troop officers placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan Surveillance Commission was relocated to Yi Prefecture, and a branch bureau of military affairs was also established there, with the commandery of horse-and-troop officers placed under its authority.

sentences.zh: 十二月，倪文俊陷岳州路，殺威順王子歹帖木兒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Ni Wenjun took Yue Prefecture and killed Prince of Weishun's son Daitemür.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Ni Wenjun captured Yue Prefecture and killed Daitemür, son of the Prince of Weishun.

sentences.zh: 湖廣參知政事也先帖木兒與左江義兵萬戶鄧祖勝合兵復衡州。

translations.literal: Yeshan Temür, vice chief minister of Huguang, together with Deng Zusheng, commander of ten thousand of the Left River Righteous Militia, combined forces and recovered Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yeshan Temür, vice chief minister of Huguang, together with Deng Zusheng, commander of ten thousand of the Left River Righteous Militia, combined forces and recovered Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔：「沿海州縣為賊所殘掠者，免田租三年。

translations.literal: That year, an edict: "In coastal prefectures and counties ravaged and plundered by bandits, land rent shall be remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: That year, an edict proclaimed: "In coastal prefectures and counties ravaged and plundered by bandits, land rent shall be remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 賜高年帛。

translations.literal: Silks shall be granted to the aged.
translations.idiomatic: Silks shall be granted to the aged.

sentences.zh: 」河南行省左丞相太不花駐軍於南陽嵩、汝等州，叛民皆降，軍勢大振。

translations.literal: Taibuhua, left chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, garrisoned troops at Nanyang, Song, Ru, and other prefectures; rebel commoners all submitted, and military strength greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: Taibuhua, left chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, garrisoned troops at Nanyang, Song, Ru, and other prefectures; rebel commoners all submitted, and his army's strength greatly revived.

sentences.zh: 陜西行臺監察御史李尚絅上《關中形勝急論》，凡十有二事。

translations.literal: Li Shangjiong, supervising censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, submitted the "Urgent Discourse on the Strategic Advantages of the Guanzhong Region," twelve items in all.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shangjiong, supervising censor of the Shaanxi branch censorate, submitted the "Urgent Discourse on the Strategic Advantages of the Guanzhong Region," twelve items in all.

sentences.zh: 命大司農司屯種雄、霸二州以給京師，號京糧。

translations.literal: An order was issued for the Grand Agribureau to garrison and cultivate at Xiong and Ba prefectures to supply the capital, designated as capital grain.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued for the Grand Agribureau to establish garrison farms at Xiong and Ba prefectures to supply grain to the capital, designated as capital provisions.
